title: Re-scan — agent verdict input
description: Written by the re-scanner agent to .github/.pipeline-context/verify/<id>.rescan.verdict.json after reading <id>.rescan.facts.md, then consumed by scripts/render-rescan.js. Answers: does the originally reported finding still trigger against the patched code?

verdict.description: FIXED: the reported finding no longer triggers by the same mechanism. STILL_VULNERABLE: it does, or an equivalent path still exists. INCONCLUSIVE: the facts bundle doesn't settle it (e.g. the worktree failed to apply).

plain_summary.description: One sentence a non-engineer would understand.

reasoning.description: Why the verdict follows from the facts. Absence of a literal signature is not proof by itself — explain whether the new construction actually removes the injection mechanism the CWE describes (cite the patched source), not just the old grep pattern.

residual_indicators.description: Anything in the patched source that still resembles the vulnerable pattern, even if not an exact signature match.
